#4057 round 3 is pushed: head 695c545e2f96d91265f62b39ef61579f32efec63 (fast-forward from 8266c27), and ci:full is re-applied.
Fixes: (1) relaunch_gate re-checks the grant after the countdown and holds again; a child-grant refusal at issuance while the grant is expired also returns to the hold. (2) The hold mail is retried on every held poll and turn boundary, deduplicated by the notifier's markers.
Regressions: a_grant_that_expires_during_the_countdown_holds_again, a_failed_hold_mail_is_retried_until_delivered, the_relaunch_wait_retries_a_failed_hold_mail. relay_grant (9) and agent_rotation (26) pass on dell1. Both mail tests fail on the old code. check-ci-fast rc=0. store-writers.toml is regenerated for the moved lease release.
Ready for your delta review.
